biography:
I began my career in 2016 as an intern with TXUE, which later became part of ENTRUST Solutions Group. Over nearly a decade, I grew from hands-on design work to managing large-scale utility distribution projects across Texas—covering pole replacement programs, subdivisions, and system improvements for both cooperatives and investor-owned utilities.

Along the way, I developed a strong foundation in utility coordination, project management, and team leadership. I’ve learned the value of building strong client relationships, leading teams through complex challenges, and delivering reliable, scalable solutions that meet high standards.

I’m excited to bring that background into the data center energy sector as an Energy Development Project Manager with Vantage Data Centers, focusing on energy procurement, transmission and substation planning, and utility partnerships that enable scalable power for world-class data campuses.
